# Cerne — Requirements and Screen Flow

Cerne is a reflective-journaling mobile app with an AI assistant. The user records their day by text, audio or photo; a conversational agent consults those records (semantic search) to answer with context and to offer insights.

This document is the product specification. The visual reference is the prototype in `docs/input/prototype/`; the backend API is documented in `docs/input/backend/`.

---

## 1. Functional requirements

### RF01 — Multimodal capture (text / audio / photo)
Data entry by text, real-time audio recording and photo upload — always through Screen 2 (Insertion Modal), which has a raw text field in addition to the microphone and the gallery. Every capture becomes a persisted record (`POST /entries`), **distinct from a chat message** (see the separation note in RF04).

**Acceptance criteria:**
- The three modalities (text, audio, photo) result in the same persisted-entry format — none is treated structurally differently from the others after capture.
- Cancelling a capture midway (e.g., interrupting a recording) does not create a partial or empty entry.

### RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing
Transcription of audio (speech-to-text) and recognition of text in images (OCR) over the content captured in RF01.

**Acceptance criteria:** four visible states — recording, processing, transcribed, transcription error.

### RF03 — Biometric authentication vault
Access barrier via Face ID / Touch ID / PIN before exposing the user's data.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- A biometric failure (e.g., fingerprint not recognized) offers PIN as an alternative, without locking the user out of the app.
- The app, sent to the background and resumed after 5 minutes, requires authentication again — it does not stay unlocked indefinitely (fixed value, not configurable by the user).

### RF04 — Interactive chat with memory (RAG)
Continuous conversation with the AI agent, with semantic search over previous entries. **Chat messages are conversational and do not create journal entries automatically** — the only exception is the explicit save action described in RF10. Otherwise, the chat queries existing entries via RAG but does not write to them.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Three mandatory UI states: processing/streaming, error, complete response.
- If the response stream drops midway, the partial message stays visible with a failure indication (it does not disappear).

### RF05 — Personal summary export
Generation of a narrative summary by AI (Claude Haiku 4.5) from the user's entries, exportable as PDF, with an additional option to download the raw data without the narrative. No clinical or diagnostic connotation. **Scope: job generation, file download and failure handling — never the quality of the generated narrative text.**

**Acceptance criteria:**
- An export job with zero entries in the period returns a handled error state (not an empty PDF, not a crash).
- A failure generating the narrative text (model timeout) still allows downloading the raw data without the narrative — the export is not blocked by an AI failure.

### RF06 — Semantic search / filter over journal entries
Semantic similarity search (via Voyage AI embeddings, reusing the ones already generated in RF01) combined with metadata filters (date, entry type). There is no filter by tag or category: the backend does not implement it in any endpoint — `GET /entries` and `GET /entries/search` accept only `source` and `dateFrom`/`dateTo`. Tags appear only embedded, read-only, in the `Entry` object (see section 2).

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Searching for a term finds semantically related entries even without the exact word (e.g., searching "ansiedade" returns an entry that only mentions "nervosismo", without the literal term).
- 300 ms search debounce: fast typing triggers a single query, not one per keystroke.
- Results from the local read cache stay consistent with the server after reconnection, without duplicating displayed items *(the architecture is cloud-only; offline allows only viewing already-cached data, not writing)*.
- Two or more filters applied at the same time (`source` + `dateFrom`/`dateTo`) narrow results with AND logic (not OR).
- Clearing the filters returns to the full list without restarting the screen.

### RF07 — Multi-source history (timeline)
A screen whose state depends simultaneously on authentication, synchronization status and entry data.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Session expiration while viewing triggers a new-login prompt without a crash and without losing the scroll position.
- The per-entry synchronization status badge updates independently of the authentication stream.
- No BLoC imports another BLoC directly.

### RF08 — Proactive insights (mechanism)
A suggestion inserted into the chat without the user asking for it. **Scope: only the trigger mechanism, never the quality of the generated text.**

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Trigger after N = 5 user messages OR T = 2 min of inactivity — fires exactly once per satisfied condition.
- If insight generation fails (timeout / network error), the main chat keeps working normally.
- Dismissing the insight does not change the scroll position or the state of the main conversation.

### RF09 — Temporal summaries / dashboard
An evolution chart with a textual summary, computed on demand when the Settings tab is opened. **Scope: aggregation and rendering, never the quality of the narrative text.**

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Renders correctly in three scenarios: zero entries, one entry, more than 30 entries.
- The aggregation recalculates correctly after an entry is created (cache-invalidation test). Entries are immutable: there is no `PATCH /entries/:id` or `DELETE /entries/:id` in the backend, and no screen describes an edit or delete action on an entry.
- The AI narrative text is checked only for not breaking the UI in extreme cases — never for its content.

### RF10 — Save a chat message as an entry
A button on each user message in the chat that converts it into a persisted entry — for moments when the user states relevant information during the conversation, not only through dedicated capture (RF01). It reuses the same `POST /entries` pipeline (PII check + embedding), with the origin marked as `chat`.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- The chat feature triggers the creation of the entry through a shared interface / use case, never by directly importing a repository or data source of the entries feature — a violation here also breaks RNF06.
- Saving the same message twice does not create duplicate entries (idempotency).
- A failure to save (network unavailable) keeps the conversation working normally, and the button returns to a state that allows trying again — the same failure-isolation pattern as RF08.
- Only user messages have the button — AI responses cannot become entries.

---

## 2. Extension features — not implemented

They keep the "essence" of the original product flow and exist in the prototype, but **receive no functional implementation**. A menu entry may exist as a placeholder.

| Original feature | Treatment in the current version |
|---|---|
| Dynamic categorization (AI) | Simplified to manual tags created by the user (My Records screen) |
| Autonomous goal extraction | Action Plans screen — static, no logic |
| Dynamic persona adjustment | Simple cosmetic toggle (Settings), low cost to maintain |

---

## 3. Quality requirements

| ID | Requirement | Target |
|---|---|---|
| RNF06 | Zero layer violations — the domain layer does not import `package:flutter` nor classes from `data/` | 0 violations |
| RNF07 | Minimum test coverage of the domain layer (`lib/**/domain/**`) | ≥ 80% |
| RNF08 | Visual fidelity to the prototype — the primary color matches the prototype's hex value, typography matches family and size, spacing matches the prototype; no visual value hardcoded outside the central file `design_tokens.dart` | Every screen faithful in color, typography and spacing; 0 hardcoded values |
| RNF09 | Consistent network-error handling — `Either<Failure, T>` pattern via `fpdart` in every repository; every write endpoint (5 endpoints) handles three failure types — timeout, malformed response, no connection — covered by tests with `mocktail` | 0 repository signatures outside the pattern; 15 of 15 scenarios handled |

## 4. Other non-functional requirements

RNF01 — Interaction latency (a local action is reflected in the UI in < 100 ms; any network call above 300 ms shows a loading indicator) · RNF02 — PII stripping (via Claude Haiku 4.5 with a structured prompt / tool use, not a dedicated NER model) · RNF03 — Zero data retention · RNF04 — RLS (Row Level Security) · RNF05 — Hard delete of account and data (LGPD).

**Known limitation:** the system has no protocol for detecting or responding to risk signals (suicidal ideation, self-harm) in entries or chat messages. Since the product is not framed as a mental-health app, this absence is an explicit scope decision.

---

## 5. Interface architecture and screen flow

### 5.1 Visual foundation (design system)
Minimalist identity, a warm and neutral palette, readable sans-serif typography, standardized components (buttons, chat bubbles, cards). This foundation is the direct object of RNF08. Tokens: `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md`.

### 5.2 Screens

**Screen 0 — Splash:** initial loading; checks the connection and syncs the cache in the background. *Connects to: RF06, RNF01.*

**Screen 0.1 — Authentication vault:** biometric/PIN barrier before access. *Connects to: RF03.*

**Screen 1 — Home (chat):** main screen, continuous conversation, "+" button for multimodal input, AI status indicator, "save to journal" button on each user message. *Connects to: RF04, RF08, RF10, RNF01, RNF09.*

**Screen 2 — Insertion Modal:** overlay with three ways to capture — raw text field, microphone (audio) and gallery/camera (photo) — with a transcription indicator. Every capture here creates a persisted entry, never a chat message. *Connects to: RF01, RF02.*

**Screen 3 — Side menu (sidebar):** navigation hub, session history, access to My Records / Action Plans / Settings, and a "Novo Chat" button that opens Screen 1 in its empty state. *Connects to: RF04 (via the "Novo Chat" button); the other items are pure navigation.*

**Screen 4 — My Records:** consolidated timeline, filters, manual tags (extension, section 2), export. *Connects to: RF07, RF06, RF05.*

**Screen 5 — Action Plans:** simple Kanban board (columns "A Fazer" / "Em Andamento" / "Concluído") with static example cards. *(Extension — section 2.)*

**Screen 6 — Settings and profile:** evolution dashboard, persona selector — "Analítico" / "Empático" / "Socrático" (extension, section 2; it would only change the system-prompt string of RF04), delete account. *Connects to: RF09, RNF05.*

---

## 6. Backend endpoint inventory

The backend is already built and frozen. The API contract, `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, is the source of truth; this section is a reading of it oriented by screen and requirement. How to build the real URL of each operation: `docs/input/backend/README.md`.

Every endpoint returns errors in the standard contract of RNF09 — `{ code, message, retryable }` — and is protected by RLS in Supabase. AI providers: Claude (chat, vision/OCR, summary, insights, dashboard, PII detection) and Voyage AI (embeddings) — the backend's only two external AI dependencies. Audio transcription (speech-to-text) runs on-device (Whisper) and never reaches the backend as an audio file.

### 6.1 Authentication and session
| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /auth/signup` | RF03 | — |
| `POST /auth/login` | RF03 | — |
| `POST /auth/refresh` | RF03, RF07 | — |
| `GET /auth/session` | RF07 | — |
| `POST /auth/logout` | RF03 | — |

**No "biometric-unlock" endpoint — intentional:** the Face ID / Touch ID / PIN barrier of Screen 0.1 is validated entirely on the device, never on the server. The backend only stores the preference (`biometricEnabled`, read and written via `PATCH /account/settings`, section 6.7) — it validates no biometrics. After passing the local barrier, the app uses the existing session (renewed via `POST /auth/refresh` when needed, or `POST /auth/login` if it has fully expired).

### 6.2 Ingestion and entries
| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /media/ocr` — the image is not persisted; only the extracted text moves on | RF02 | Claude Haiku 4.5 (vision) |
| `POST /entries` — creates an entry; internally triggers the PII check and embedding generation; accepts `source` (`manual`/`audio`/`photo`/`chat`) and `chatMessageId` when the origin is the chat | RF01, RF02, RF10 | Claude Haiku 4.5 (PII) + Voyage AI (embedding) |
| `GET /entries` — filters by `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo`; tags appear only embedded in the response, read-only | RF07 | — |
| `GET /entries/:id` | RF07 | — |

**No entry editing or deletion, and no tag endpoint — intentional:** entries are immutable once created ("original content intact, never censored"); there is no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`. Tags are populated only by test seed data — no endpoint creates, deletes or filters by tag or category (see RF06). This is consistent with section 2: dynamic categorization was simplified to manual tags that receive no functional implementation.

### 6.3 Chat and memory (RAG)
| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /chat/sessions` — blocked offline | RF04 | — |
| `GET /chat/sessions` — works offline (cache) | RF04, RF07 | — |
| `GET /chat/sessions/:id/messages` — works offline (cache) | RF04 | — |
| `POST /chat/sessions/:id/messages` — streaming (SSE); blocked offline | RF04 | Voyage AI (question embedding) + Claude Sonnet 5 (response) |
| `POST /chat/sessions/:id/messages/:userMessageId/retry` — regenerates the response without duplicating the user's question; it supports "partial message visible with a failure indication, and a way to try again" in RF04 | RF04 | Voyage AI (embedding, reused from cache) + Claude Sonnet 5 (response) |
| `POST /chat/sessions/:id/insight` | RF08 | Claude Haiku 4.5 |
| `POST /entries` — called from the "save to journal" button (see 6.2) | RF10 | Claude Haiku 4.5 (PII) + Voyage AI (embedding) |

### 6.4 Search
| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /entries/search?q=&source=&dateFrom=&dateTo=&limit=` — no `category` (see RF06) | RF06 | Voyage AI (query embedding) |

### 6.5 Export
| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /export/summary` — asynchronous job | RF05 | Claude Haiku 4.5 |
| `GET /export/:jobId/status` | RF05 | — |
| `GET /export/:jobId/download` | RF05 | — |

### 6.6 Dashboard
| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /dashboard/aggregate?period=` — separate from the text so it does not block the chart | RF09 | — |
| `GET /dashboard/narrative?period=` | RF09 | Claude Haiku 4.5 |

### 6.7 Account
| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
|---|---|---|
| `PATCH /account/settings` — includes the persona toggle (extension) | RNF05, extension | — |
| `DELETE /account` | RNF05 | — |

---

## 7. Integrated flowchart — screens × requirements × backend

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph T0["Screen 0 — Splash"]
        direction TB
        E01["GET /auth/session"]
    end

    subgraph T01["Screen 0.1 — Authentication vault · RF03"]
        direction TB
        E02b["Face ID / Touch ID / PIN — validated on the device, no backend call"]
        E02["POST /auth/login (if the session has fully expired)"]
    end

    subgraph T1["Screen 1 — Home (chat) · RF04, RF08, RF10"]
        direction TB
        E04["POST /chat/sessions"]
        E05["GET /chat/sessions/:id/messages"]
        E06["POST /chat/sessions/:id/messages"]
        E06b["POST .../messages/:userMessageId/retry"]
        E07["POST /chat/sessions/:id/insight"]
        E07b["POST /entries (save message)"]
    end

    subgraph T2["Screen 2 — Insertion modal · RF01, RF02"]
        direction TB
        E08["POST /media/ocr"]
        E09["POST /entries"]
    end

    subgraph T3["Screen 3 — Side menu"]
        direction TB
        E10["GET /chat/sessions"]
        E10b["'Novo Chat' button — opens T1 empty, backed by E04"]
    end

    subgraph T4["Screen 4 — My records · RF05, RF06, RF07"]
        direction TB
        E11["GET /entries (source/dateFrom/dateTo — no category)"]
        E12["GET /entries/search"]
        E15["POST /export/summary"]
        E15b["GET /export/:jobId/status"]
        E16["GET /export/:jobId/download"]
    end

    subgraph T5["Screen 5 — Action plans (extension)"]
        direction TB
        E17["No calls — static"]
    end

    subgraph T6["Screen 6 — Settings · RF09, RNF05"]
        direction TB
        E18["GET /dashboard/aggregate"]
        E19["GET /dashboard/narrative"]
        E20["PATCH /account/settings"]
        E21["DELETE /account"]
        E22["POST /auth/logout"]
    end

    T0 --> T01 --> T1
    T1 --> T2
    T1 --> T3
    T3 -->|Novo Chat| T1
    T3 --> T4
    T3 --> T5
    T3 --> T6

    style T5 fill:#FAEEDA,stroke:#BA7517,color:#412402
```

*(The amber "Action plans" subgraph marks the only screen with no backend calls — a product extension.)*

---

## 8. Data model (reference)

Main entities of the backend (Supabase / Postgres). Field names are reference suggestions, not mandatory character by character. **Where this table differs from the API contract (`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`), the contract prevails** (see section 6).

| Table | Main fields | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `users` | id, email, biometric_enabled, persona, created_at | RLS: a user accesses only their own row |
| `entries` | id, user_id, content, source (`manual`/`audio`/`photo`/`chat`), chat_message_id (nullable), embedding (vector, see 9), sync_status, created_at, updated_at | `embedding` generated in `POST /entries` via Voyage AI |
| `tags` | id, user_id, name | Extension — created manually by the user |
| `entry_tags` | entry_id, tag_id | N:N join table |
| `chat_sessions` | id, user_id, title, created_at | — |
| `chat_messages` | id, session_id, role (`user`/`assistant`), content, created_at | User messages show the RF10 button |
| `export_jobs` | id, user_id, status (`pending`/`processing`/`done`/`error`), period_start, period_end, file_url, created_at | Asynchronous — see 6.5 |

**RLS pattern (every table with `user_id`):** policy `auth.uid() = user_id`, no exceptions.

---

## 9. Technology stack

| Layer | Choice |
|---|---|
| Mobile app | Flutter, BLoC, Clean Architecture |
| Backend | Already built and frozen; consumed through its API |
| Infrastructure | Supabase (Postgres + pgvector + Storage + Auth + RLS) |
| Chat / vision / OCR / summary / insights / dashboard / PII | Claude Sonnet 5 (chat) + Claude Haiku 4.5 (the rest) — in the backend |
| Embeddings (RAG) | Voyage AI `voyage-4` — in the backend |
| Speech-to-text (audio transcription) | Whisper on-device (`whisper_ggml`); audio never reaches the backend |
| Error handling | `fpdart` (`Either<Failure, T>`) |
| Layer rule | RNF06 |
| Test coverage | RNF07 |

---

## 10. Configuration parameters

Fixed values — not to be reinterpreted.

| Parameter | Value | Requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Background session timeout | 5 min | RF03 |
| Search debounce | 300 ms | RF06 |
| Proactive insight trigger | 5 messages OR 2 min of inactivity | RF08 |
| Dashboard rendering scenarios | 0 / 1 / > 30 entries | RF09 |
| Minimum test coverage (domain) | ≥ 80% | RNF07 |
| Local UI latency | < 100 ms | RNF01 |
| Loading-indicator threshold | > 300 ms | RNF01 |
| Network-error scenarios tested | 5 endpoints × 3 failures = 15 | RNF09 |

---

## 11. Error codes (RNF09)

Every endpoint returns `{ code, message, retryable }`. Minimum codes the app handles:

| Code | Situation | `retryable` |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_EXPIRED` | Session expired, re-authentication needed | no |
| `AUTH_INVALID` | Invalid credentials / biometrics | no |
| `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` | Request exceeded the time limit | yes |
| `NETWORK_OFFLINE` | No connection — action blocked (see RF04/RF06) | yes |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Malformed request body | no |
| `PII_CHECK_FAILED` | PII check failed before persisting | yes |
| `EMBEDDING_FAILED` | Voyage AI unavailable / error | yes |
| `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` | Claude did not respond in time (chat/insight/summary/dashboard) | yes |
| `NOT_FOUND` | Resource does not exist or does not belong to the user | no |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | Request limit exceeded | yes |

The complete, closed list of the backend's 13 codes, with HTTP statuses, is in `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md`.

---

## 12. Delivery order

Work is delivered in units, one per functional requirement, preceded by a foundation unit, in this order:

**F000 → RF03 → RF01 → RF02 → RF07 → RF06 → RF04 → RF10 → RF08 → RF05 → RF09**

- **F000 (foundation)** covers what no single requirement owns but all of them use: project scaffold, `design_tokens.dart`, HTTP client returning `Either`, login and sign-up (Screen 0.1a in the prototype), base navigation and expired-session handling.
- RF10 comes after RF01 and RF04; RF08 comes after RF04.

---

## 13. Technical constraints

**Fixed:**
- Flutter and Dart at the version pinned for the repository (fvm).
- State management: `flutter_bloc`.
- Clean Architecture, three layers per feature.
- Error handling: `fpdart`; repositories return `Either<Failure, T>`.
- Test doubles: `mocktail`.
- On-device speech-to-text: `whisper_ggml`.
- Visual tokens: `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` is the single source of colors, typography, spacing and radii.
- Platform: iOS, portrait only.
- Folder convention:

```
lib/
  core/
  features/
    <feature>/
      data/
      domain/
      presentation/
```

**Free (choose what fits):** routing, HTTP client, local cache, dependency injection, secure storage, biometrics package, chart package.

1:# Cerne — Prototype extract
2:
3:The visual reference of the product is `cerne-prototype.html` (this folder). Open it in a browser; it needs JavaScript. This extract lists its navigable states, its visual tokens, its components and the implementation notes that come with it.
4:
5:- **Frame:** 390 × 844 logical points, portrait only, 4 dp grid.
6:- **Language of the interface:** Portuguese. Every UI text below appears exactly as in the prototype, in quotes.
7:- **Precedence:** the prototype defines appearance and states. Behavior rules (triggers, timings, filters, error handling) are defined in `docs/input/requirements.md`; where the prototype's simulated behavior differs from a requirement, the requirement prevails.
8:
9:---
10:
11:## 1. Navigation map
12:
13:The prototype has **32 navigable states**, reachable from a single state machine (a `screen` variable plus overlay flags). Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).
14:
15:```
16:Splash (auto, 1.8 s)
17:  └─> Biometria ──tap/error──> PIN inicial / PIN após falha
18:  │      └─> "usar e-mail e senha" ──> Entrar / criar conta (toggle)
19:  │                                          └─> submit ──> Home/Chat
20:  └─(PIN complete, 4 digits)──> Home/Chat
21:  └─(Face ID/Touch ID ok)──> Home/Chat
22:
23:Home/Chat (base screen)
24:  ├─ overlay: Sessão expirada (backend session expires; "Entrar novamente" ──> Biometria)
25:  ├─ overlay: side menu (☰ icon) ──> Meus Registros | Planos de Ação | Configurações | new conversation
26:  └─ overlay: Insertion modal ("+" button) ──> tabs Texto / Áudio / Foto, each with its own sub-states
27:        (on save, the modal closes and returns to Home/Chat with the record added)
28:
29:Meus Registros (base screen, from the side menu)
30:  ├─ empty state (no records) ──CTA "Criar primeiro registro"──> Insertion modal
...
### 2.3 Insertion modal (bottom sheet over Home/Chat; 9 states)
Common structure: "x" to close and a 3-tab bar (Texto / Áudio / Foto); the active tab has a filled dark-green background.

| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Texto | Multiline field, placeholder "Escreva livremente...", button "Salvar". |
| Áudio — Gravando | Red stop button, animated 12-bar waveform, monospace timer (e.g., "00:12"). |
| Áudio — Processando | Spinner in place of stop; frozen, faded waveform (opacity .35); text "Transcrevendo..."; label "00:42 de áudio". |
| Áudio — Transcrito | Editable transcribed text; original audio duration in mono; "Salvar" enabled. |
| Áudio — Erro | Red warning icon, "Não foi possível transcrever", outline button "Tentar novamente". |
| Foto — Captura | Two large buttons, "Câmera" and "Galeria". |
| Foto — Processando OCR | Photo thumbnail, spinner, "Reconhecendo texto...". |
| Foto — Reconhecido | Small thumbnail next to the extracted (editable) text; "Salvar". |
| Foto — Erro | Thumbnail kept, warning icon, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto", button "Tentar novamente" and secondary text action "Salvar só a foto". |

### 2.4 Records
=== SECTION 4 ===
## 4. Special states that need extra care

- **Expired session:** an overlay on the chat that keeps history and scroll position — the expired token must not discard the conversation state in memory before re-authentication. Re-authenticating goes back to the Biometria screen, not to a full form.
- **Offline:** blocks **sending new messages** (send icon disabled, explanatory banner), but **history stays visible and navigable**. The prototype does not show what happens to the insertion modal (text/audio/photo) when offline.
- **Asynchronous processing — audio transcription:** a loading state (spinner + frozen waveform) and two outcomes (success/error); the error always offers "Tentar novamente" and never loses the recorded audio.
- **Asynchronous processing — photo OCR:** same pattern as audio, with one extra exit on error: "Salvar só a foto", which saves the record even without extracted text.
- **Asynchronous processing — export:** two loading stages (preparing → generating the AI summary) before the result; on error, the raw data is always available for download — the failure is isolated to the AI narrative, never to the user's data.
- **Dashboard narrative unavailable:** the chart loads normally but the AI summary paragraph fails — distinct from "zero entries" (lack of data) and needs its own error message.

---

## 5. Implementation notes

quickstart.md for the manual iOS Simulator verification Stories 1–4 and their Edge Cases need.

**Target Platform**: iOS, portrait only — unchanged. `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` raised from
`15.0` to `15.6` (research.md R2, `whisper_ggml`'s documented floor) across all three build
configurations in `ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`. Three new `Info.plist` usage-description
strings (`NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`, `NSCameraUsageDescription`,
`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` — research.md R1/R3); no other native project change.

**Project Type**: Same single Flutter mobile app. This unit adds two new feature folders —
`lib/features/entries/` (the shared entry-creation seam, research.md R8) and
`lib/features/capture/` (the Insertion Modal UI and its audio/photo pipelines) — and touches one
existing F000 file (`home_chat_shell_page.dart`, to add the real "+" button — research.md R9). No
backend/server code, no change to `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`.

**Performance Goals**: RNF01 — every network call this unit makes (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`)
shows the existing plain loading indicator (`DesignTokens.sizeLoadingIndicator`/
`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator`, already present from F000/RF03) whenever it exceeds 300 ms; the one
local action with its own 100 ms bar is the Texto tab's "Salvar" enabled/disabled toggle as the
field's emptiness changes, and the Áudio tab's recording starting "immediately" on tab activation.

**Constraints**:
- No RF02 dedicated recognition-state screens (processing/transcribed/recognized/error with their
  own styling), no editable review step, no modality-specific retry affordances ("Tentar
  novamente" styled to match RF02's named Erro states, "Salvar só a foto") — FR-007, research.md
  R11. This unit's own failure/retry UI is deliberately plainer than the prototype's named "Erro"
  states, per spec.md's own resolved Clarification 1.
- No RF04/RF05/RF06/RF07/RF08/RF09/RF10 behavior, no extension feature (manual tags/categories,
  action plans, persona selection) — FR-012.
- No backend/contract/config change (FR-013) — only two already-existing functions are called
  (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`), with request bodies limited to exactly the fields this unit
  needs (data-model.md).
- Audio content never reaches the backend (Constitution Principle II) — transcription is entirely
  on-device via `whisper_ggml`; only its resulting text is ever sent, as an `entries-create` body.
- Clean Architecture, 3 layers per feature (Principle V); `entries/domain/` and `capture/domain/`
  stay free of `package:flutter`, `record`, `image_picker`, and `whisper_ggml` types — see
  contracts/*.md.
- Zero visual values hardcoded outside `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (Principle IV/RNF08) — this
  unit needs no new token (research.md R10), reusing F000/RF03's existing scale entirely.

**Scale/Scope**: 1 new "+" button on an existing screen (research.md R9); 1 new bottom-sheet page
(`InsertionModalPage`) with 3 tab widgets, backed by 1 screen-scoped bloc covering 11 sub-states
across the three tabs (contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md); 2 new feature folders
(`entries`, `capture`) with 2 new network-backed repositories (`EntriesRepository`,
`PhotoRecognitionRepository`, both `Either<Failure, T>`) plus 2 new device-only repositories
(`AudioCaptureRepository`, `PhotoCaptureRepository`) and 1 on-device-only repository
(`AudioTranscriptionRepository`, `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>` — not the backend taxonomy); 1 new
cross-cutting `ConnectivityChecker` in `core/network/`, reusable by later offline-gated units.

section.*

Product Source of Truth | PASS | `docs/input/` read-only; this unit's one genuinely silent spot (how "confirming Save" maps to a concrete user action per modality, and how far this unit's own failure UI may deviate from the prototype's named Erro states) was resolved by reasonable technical judgment, documented in research.md R6/R11, building directly on spec.md's own already-resolved Clarifications rather than reopening them. |

Fixed Technology Stack | PASS | `flutter_bloc`/`fpdart`/`mocktail` reused as-is. `whisper_ggml` is Principle II's explicit, non-negotiable choice for speech-to-text (research.md R2) — audio never reaches the backend. `record`/`image_picker`/`connectivity_plus`/`path_provider` are incidental, non-conflicting additions needed to implement literal FRs (FR-004/FR-005/FR-010), in the same category RF03's `crypto` addition already set precedent for. |

content.content:
## R5 — Blocking Save while offline (FR-010)

- **Decision**: A new `core/network/connectivity_checker.dart` (`ConnectivityChecker`, wrapping
  `connectivity_plus`'s `Connectivity().checkConnectivity()`) exposes a plain `Future<bool>
  hasConnection()` — true unless the result is `ConnectivityResult.none`. Every Save path (text,
  audio, photo) checks this *first*, before any transcription/OCR/entry-creation work, and if it is
  `false`, fails immediately with `NetworkOfflineFailure` without calling `ApiClient` at all.
- **Rationale**: FR-010/SC-005 and the Edge Cases explicitly want the block to happen "without
  attempting a network call that cannot succeed" — a reactive catch of `ApiClient`'s own
  `NetworkOfflineFailure` (which already exists and already fires on a real failed call) would
  satisfy the *error-handling* half of RNF09 but not this specific "don't even try" requirement, so
  a proactive, synchronous-feeling pre-check is needed in addition. Checking before transcription
  too (not just before the `entries-create` call) gives the snappier "blocked immediately" behavior
  FR-010 asks for, and avoids running on-device Whisper inference or an OCR round-trip for a save
  that cannot complete regardless. `connectivity_plus` lives in `core/` (not inside the `capture`
  feature) because it is the same cross-cutting, interface-level connectivity concern
  spec.md's own Assumptions say "already established elsewhere in the product (chat, search)" —
  later units (RF04, RF06) blocking their own writes/sends while offline will reuse this exact
  checker rather than each growing its own.
- **Known limitation, accepted**: `connectivity_plus` reports OS-level interface state (Wi-Fi/
  cellular/none), not actual internet reachability — a device on Wi-Fi with no upstream internet
  still reads as "connected." Adding a live reachability probe (e.g. pinging the backend) would be
  disproportionate machinery for a check whose whole purpose is to avoid an extra network round
  trip; the existing reactive `NetworkOfflineFailure` path (R-nothing-new) still catches that
  residual case when the real `entries-create` call is attempted.
- **Alternatives considered**: Relying solely on `ApiClient`'s existing reactive mapping — rejected
  per the "without attempting a network call" wording above. A full reachability ping before every
  save — rejected as disproportionate for the stated requirement.

## R6 — "Confirming Save" is a different user action per modality

- **Decision**: There is no second, explicit "Salvar" tap for the Áudio or Foto tabs. Per spec.md's
  own Acceptance Scenarios: for **Texto**, "confirming Save" is the user tapping the tab's "Salvar"
  button (User Story 1, FR-003). For **Áudio**, it is the user tapping the stop control (User Story
  2 Scenario 2: "the user taps stop... the system automatically transcribes it and completes the
  save"). For **Foto**, it is the picker returning a selected/captured image (User Story 3 Scenario
  2: "that image is provided... the system automatically extracts its text and completes the
  save"). None of the three needs or gets an intermediate editable-text review screen with its own
  "Salvar" button — that reviewable state (prototype's "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido") is exactly what
  spec.md's Clarification 1 reserves for RF02.
- **Rationale**: Re-building a second confirmation tap for audio/photo would recreate the
  editable-review step FR-007 explicitly forbids, and would contradict the Acceptance Scenarios'
  own wording ("completes the save" as the direct, same-step outcome of stopping/providing — not a
  precursor to a later explicit save action). This is the detail most likely to be
  over-engineered by accident during implementation, so it is called out here explicitly rather
  than left implicit in data-model.md's transition tables alone.
- **Alternatives considered**: Adding a plain (non-RF02-styled) "Salvar" button after recognition
  succeeds, before creating the entry — rejected: it would be an invented intermediate step with no
  basis in the Acceptance Scenarios, and would reintroduce exactly the kind of extra tap SC-003
  ("no required intermediate screens") argues against.

## R7 — Local recognition failures are not backend `Failure`s

- **Decision**: `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(...)` returns
  `Either<RecognitionFailure, String>`, where `RecognitionFailure` is a small new sealed type local
  to the `capture` feature's domain layer (`emptyResult | transcriptionError`) — **not** a new
  subtype added to `core/network/failure.dart`. `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize(...)`, by
  contrast, *does* return `Either<Failure, OcrResult>` using the existing, unmodified `Failure`
  hierarchy, because it is a real network call to `media-ocr` and the backend's closed taxonomy
  already has the exact code this path needs (`OcrNoTextFailure` / `OCR_NO_TEXT`, already present in
  `failure.dart` since F000).
- **Rationale**: This mirrors RF03's research.md R5 precedent exactly: `core/network/failure.dart`
  is scoped to the backend's 13-code closed taxonomy (a *server* response can say
  `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`; it cannot say "the microphone recording was silent"). On-device Whisper
  returning an empty/whitespace transcript, or throwing internally, is a purely local condition
  with no corresponding backend code — forcing it through `Either<Failure, T>` would mean either
  inventing a fake backend-shaped code for something the backend never sees, or diluting the
  "closed" taxonomy's scope. OCR, conversely, is a real backend round trip whose own contract
  already names this exact failure mode — no new type needed there at all.
- **Alternatives considered**: One shared `Either<Failure, T>` surface for both audio and photo
  recognition, adding a new local-only `Failure` subtype for the audio case — rejected for the same
  reason RF03 rejected modeling PIN/biometric outcomes that way: it would grow a taxonomy the
  spec and RNF09 treat as backend-defined with a code no network response will ever actually send.

## R8 — A shared entry-creation seam, because RF10 already names it

- **Decision**: `Entry` (full response shape), `EntriesRepository` (create today; later units add

content.content:
## R10 — New design tokens

- **Decision**: Reuse everything already in `design_tokens.dart` — F000/RF03 already added
  `sizeLoadingIndicator`/`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator` (the plain generic loading indicator FR-007
  needs), `colorError` (stop button, failure text/icon), `colorPrimary` (waveform bars, filled tab
  background, primary buttons), `colorBorder`/`colorSurfaceElevated` (outline buttons for "Câmera"/
  "Galeria" and the generic "Tentar novamente" retry action), and the full type scale. The "frozen
  and faded" look of a processing waveform (prototype: opacity `.35`) is applied with a plain
  `Opacity` widget around the (already-tokenized-color) bars, not a new token — an opacity
  multiplier is not itself a color/typography/spacing/radius value under RNF08's enumeration, the
  same reasoning that already lets `elevation1`/`elevation2` bake their own alpha into the token
  file without every *use* of alpha elsewhere needing a dedicated token.
- **No new tokens needed.** Unlike RF03 (which needed `sizeKeypadTapTarget`,
  `sizeBiometricIconContainer`, `sizeBiometricIcon` for a shape the existing scale had no
  equivalent for), RF01's three tabs — a plain multiline field, a timer/waveform/stop-button row,
  and two large buttons — are all composed from F000's existing spacing/radius/typography scale and
  the component-library entries already named in prototype-extract.md §6 ("Primary button",
  "Secondary button (outline)", "Text field").

## R11 — Why this unit's own failure/retry UI is allowed to look different from the prototype's named "Erro" states

- **Decision**: The audio/photo failure UI this unit builds (FR-009) is a plain message plus one
  generic retry action, styled from existing tokens (`colorError` text, a ghost/outline button) —
  it does **not** reproduce the prototype's specific "Áudio — Erro" / "Foto — Erro" component specs
  verbatim (prototype-extract.md §2.3: the red warning icon treatment, the exact copy "Não foi
  possível transcrever"/"Não foi possível reconhecer o texto", the specific outline button styled
  as that named state, or Foto-Erro's second action "Salvar só a foto").
- **Rationale**: This looks, at first glance, like an RNF08 violation ("every screen MUST be
  faithful to the prototype") — but RNF08's fidelity obligation applies to states this unit actually
  implements. The "Erro" states as named in the prototype are explicitly, by spec.md's own
  Clarification 1, RF02's screens to build ("this unit MUST NOT present... a dedicated multi-state
  screen... or modality-specific retry affordances such as 'Tentar novamente' or 'Salvar só a
  foto'" — FR-007). FR-009 still requires *some* failure-and-retry behavior to exist for this unit's
  own narrower pipeline (transcription-or-save failing), so this unit necessarily renders its own,
  undocumented-by-the-prototype failure view — one the spec's Clarification already pre-approved as
  not needing to match RF02's specific look. This is not a new judgment call; it is carrying the
  spec's own already-resolved Clarification 1 through to its concrete UI consequence, called out
  here so a later reviewer does not mistake the deliberately plainer failure view for an
  overlooked fidelity gap.
- **Alternatives considered**: Reusing the prototype's exact "Erro" copy/iconography now and simply
  omitting the "Tentar novamente"/"Salvar só a foto" *buttons* — rejected: the copy and icon
  treatment are as much a part of the named, RF02-reserved state as its buttons are; partially
  borrowing its look while structurally not being that state would be a confusing hybrid, not a
  faithful implementation of either unit's scope.

## R12 — Correction: the "Áudio" tab has its own idle state, it does not auto-start recording

  same reasoning that already lets `elevation1`/`elevation2` bake their own alpha into the token
  file without every *use* of alpha elsewhere needing a dedicated token.
- **No new tokens needed.** Unlike RF03 (which needed `sizeKeypadTapTarget`,
  `sizeBiometricIconContainer`, `sizeBiometricIcon` for a shape the existing scale had no
  equivalent for), RF01's three tabs — a plain multiline field, a timer/waveform/stop-button row,
  and two large buttons — are all composed from F000's existing spacing/radius/typography scale and
  the component-library entries already named in prototype-extract.md §6 ("Primary button",
  "Secondary button (outline)", "Text field").

## R11 — Why this unit's own failure/retry UI is allowed to look different from the prototype's named "Erro" states

- **Decision**: The audio/photo failure UI this unit builds (FR-009) is a plain message plus one
  generic retry action, styled from existing tokens (`colorError` text, a ghost/outline button) —
  it does **not** reproduce the prototype's specific "Áudio — Erro" / "Foto — Erro" component specs
  verbatim (prototype-extract.md §2.3: the red warning icon treatment, the exact copy "Não foi
  possível transcrever"/"Não foi possível reconhecer o texto", the specific outline button styled
  as that named state, or Foto-Erro's second action "Salvar só a foto").
- **Rationale**: This looks, at first glance, like an RNF08 violation ("every screen MUST be
  faithful to the prototype") — but RNF08's fidelity obligation applies to states this unit actually
  implements. The "Erro" states as named in the prototype are explicitly, by spec.md's own
  Clarification 1, RF02's screens to build ("this unit MUST NOT present... a dedicated multi-state
  screen... or modality-specific retry affordances such as 'Tentar novamente' or 'Salvar só a
  foto'" — FR-007). FR-009 still requires *some* failure-and-retry behavior to exist for this unit's
  own narrower pipeline (transcription-or-save failing), so this unit necessarily renders its own,
  undocumented-by-the-prototype failure view — one the spec's Clarification already pre-approved as
  not needing to match RF02's specific look. This is not a new judgment call; it is carrying the
  spec's own already-resolved Clarification 1 through to its concrete UI consequence, called out
  here so a later reviewer does not mistake the deliberately plainer failure view for an
  overlooked fidelity gap.
- **Alternatives considered**: Reusing the prototype's exact "Erro" copy/iconography now and simply
  omitting the "Tentar novamente"/"Salvar só a foto" *buttons* — rejected: the copy and icon
  treatment are as much a part of the named, RF02-reserved state as its buttons are; partially
  borrowing its look while structurally not being that state would be a confusing hybrid, not a
  faithful implementation of either unit's scope.

## R12 — Correction: the "Áudio" tab has its own idle state, it does not auto-start recording

1	# Data Model: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture
2	
3	Source: spec.md §Key Entities, requirements.md §§1, 6.2, 9 (data model reference), §13, and
4	`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` and `/media/ocr` schemas. This unit introduces
5	one new backend-shaped entity (`Entry`, read from a contract the backend already defines — no
6	schema change) and one ephemeral, device-only, non-persisted "entity" (Capture Session, modeled as
7	presentation state, not a domain type — see research.md R8 for why `Entry`/`EntriesRepository`
8	live in a new `entries` feature, separate from `capture`).
9	
10	## Entry (`lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`)
11	
12	The full shape of `POST /entries`' response — every field below is `required` in the OpenAPI
13	schema on every response, so none is optional to model (research.md R8).
14	
15	| Field | Type | Notes |
16	|---|---|---|
17	| `id` | `String` (uuid) | Server-assigned. |
18	| `content` | `String` | 1–20000 chars; the text this unit always supplies non-empty (FR-003/Edge Cases — never an empty/near-empty entry). |
19	| `source` | `EntrySource` | `manual` \| `audio` \| `photo` for this unit (see below — `chat` is RF10's addition). |
20	| `chatMessageId` | `String?` (uuid) | Always `null` for every entry this unit creates. |
21	| `occurredAt` | `DateTime` | Server-assigned; this unit never sends its own value in the request. |
22	| `tags` | `List<EntryTag>` | Always empty for a freshly created entry (tags are the manual-tagging extension, out of scope — requirements.md §2); modeled so later units reading an `Entry` don't need a second type. |
23	| `piiStatus` | `PiiStatus` (`pending`\|`clean`\|`flagged`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; this unit does not branch on it. |
24	| `piiSpans` | `List<PiiSpan>` | As returned; not rendered by this unit. |
25	| `embeddingStatus` | `EmbeddingStatus` (`pending`\|`ready`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; not rendered by this unit. |
26	| `mediaDurationSeconds` | `int?` | This unit never sends it in the request, so it is always `null` on the response to an entry this unit creates. |
27	| `serverRevision` | `int` | Opaque; not used by this unit. |
28	| `createdAt` | `DateTime` | — |
29	| `updatedAt` | `DateTime` | — |
30	
31	```dart
32	enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo }         // `chat` added by RF10, not here (research.md R8)
33	enum PiiStatus { pending, clean, flagged, failed }
34	enum EmbeddingStatus { pending, ready, failed }
35	
36	class EntryTag { final String id; final String name; }
37	class PiiSpan { final int start; final int end; final String type; }
38	```
39	
40	**Validation rule**: `content` is never sent empty or whitespace-only — enforced before any of the
41	three save usecases ever calls `CreateEntryUseCase` (Texto: the "Salvar" action is itself disabled
42	on an empty field, FR-003; Audio/Photo: an empty/whitespace recognized result is treated as a
43	recognition failure, not forwarded to entry creation — Edge Cases).
44	
45	## `EntriesRepository` (`lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`)
46	
47	```dart
48	abstract class EntriesRepository {
49	  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source});
50	  List<Entry> get cachedEntries;   // FR-011's "local entries store/cache" — in-memory, this process's lifetime

# Data Model: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

Source: spec.md §Key Entities, requirements.md §§1, 6.2, 9 (data model reference), §13, and
`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` and `/media/ocr` schemas. This unit introduces
one new backend-shaped entity (`Entry`, read from a contract the backend already defines — no
schema change) and one ephemeral, device-only, non-persisted "entity" (Capture Session, modeled as
presentation state, not a domain type — see research.md R8 for why `Entry`/`EntriesRepository`
live in a new `entries` feature, separate from `capture`).

## Entry (`lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`)

The full shape of `POST /entries`' response — every field below is `required` in the OpenAPI
schema on every response, so none is optional to model (research.md R8).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `String` (uuid) | Server-assigned. |
| `content` | `String` | 1–20000 chars; the text this unit always supplies non-empty (FR-003/Edge Cases — never an empty/near-empty entry). |
| `source` | `EntrySource` | `manual` \| `audio` \| `photo` for this unit (see below — `chat` is RF10's addition). |
| `chatMessageId` | `String?` (uuid) | Always `null` for every entry this unit creates. |
| `occurredAt` | `DateTime` | Server-assigned; this unit never sends its own value in the request. |
| `tags` | `List<EntryTag>` | Always empty for a freshly created entry (tags are the manual-tagging extension, out of scope — requirements.md §2); modeled so later units reading an `Entry` don't need a second type. |
| `piiStatus` | `PiiStatus` (`pending`\|`clean`\|`flagged`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; this unit does not branch on it. |
| `piiSpans` | `List<PiiSpan>` | As returned; not rendered by this unit. |
| `embeddingStatus` | `EmbeddingStatus` (`pending`\|`ready`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; not rendered by this unit. |
| `mediaDurationSeconds` | `int?` | This unit never sends it in the request, so it is always `null` on the response to an entry this unit creates. |
| `serverRevision` | `int` | Opaque; not used by this unit. |
| `createdAt` | `DateTime` | — |
| `updatedAt` | `DateTime` | — |

```dart
enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo }         // `chat` added by RF10, not here (research.md R8)
enum PiiStatus { pending, clean, flagged, failed }
enum EmbeddingStatus { pending, ready, failed }

class EntryTag { final String id; final String name; }
class PiiSpan { final int start; final int end; final String type; }
```

**Validation rule**: `content` is never sent empty or whitespace-only — enforced before any of the
three save usecases ever calls `CreateEntryUseCase` (Texto: the "Salvar" action is itself disabled
on an empty field, FR-003; Audio/Photo: an empty/whitespace recognized result is treated as a
recognition failure, not forwarded to entry creation — Edge Cases).

## `EntriesRepository` (`lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`)

```dart
abstract class EntriesRepository {
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source});
  List<Entry> get cachedEntries;   // FR-011's "local entries store/cache" — in-memory, this process's lifetime
}
```

- `create()` posts to `entries-create` via the existing, unmodified `ApiClient`/`Failure` hierarchy
  — no new `Failure` subtype (every backend error this call can realistically return —
  `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `PII_CHECK_FAILED`, `EMBEDDING_FAILED`, `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`,
  `NETWORK_OFFLINE`, `RATE_LIMITED` — already exists in `core/network/failure.dart`).
- `EntriesRepositoryImpl` is registered as a `get_it` `lazySingleton` (the same pattern
  `VaultRepository` uses for its own in-memory, process-lifetime state — RF03 research.md R3) so
  `cachedEntries` survives across modal opens/closes without a local database. On a successful
  `create()`, the returned `Entry` is appended to this in-memory list before the `Either` is
  returned to the caller. Nothing in this unit ever *reads* `cachedEntries` back out for display —
  it exists purely so RF07 (the first unit that reads entries for a screen) has something to read
  from day one, per FR-011's explicit forward reference to "Meus Registros, RF07."

## `CreateEntryUseCase` (`lib/features/entries/domain/usecases/create_entry_usecase.dart`)

```dart
class CreateEntryUseCase {
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> call(String content, EntrySource source) =>
      repository.create(content: content, source: source);
}
```

The one and only sanctioned way any other feature creates an entry (research.md R8) — `capture`'s
three save usecases below depend on this, never on `EntriesRepository` directly.

## Capture Session (presentation-only state — not a domain entity, not persisted)

Spec.md's Key Entities names this as "ephemeral, device-only state that exists only while the
Insertion Modal is open" — in this codebase's existing convention (mirrors RF03's "Presentation-
only state" section: `VaultMode`, the in-progress first PIN entry), this is `InsertionModalBloc`'s
own state plus two bloc-private fields, not a type any other layer sees:

| Held where | What | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|
| `InsertionModalState` (public, see contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md) | active tab + that tab's own idle/recording/saving/failure sub-state + the Texto draft text | One `InsertionModalBloc` instance per modal open; discarded (never persisted) when the modal closes, satisfying FR-002's "reset every tab... each time the modal is freshly opened" by construction — a fresh bloc is created on every `showModalBottomSheet` call. |
| `_pendingAudioPath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The WAV file path `AudioCaptureRepository` wrote to, kept only so a failed transcribe-or-save can retry (FR-009) without re-recording. Cleared on successful save, on modal close, or on switching away from the Áudio tab (Edge Cases: switching tabs mid-recording discards it). | Same as above. |
| `_pendingImagePath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The JPEG file path `PhotoCaptureRepository` returned, kept for the same FR-009 retry-without-recapture reason. | Same as above. |

No field here is ever written to disk or to the backend as its own record — only a *successful*
recognition's resulting text ever becomes part of an `Entry` via `CreateEntryUseCase`.

## State transitions (per modality, per research.md R6: "confirming Save" is a different trigger each time)

```
Modal opens (showModalBottomSheet, fresh InsertionModalBloc)
  -> InsertionModalTexto(text: '')                              # FR-002 default tab

[Texto tab]
  TextDraftChanged(text) -> InsertionModalTexto(text)            # Salvar enabled iff text.trim().isNotEmpty (FR-003)
  SaveTextSubmitted (text non-empty, not already in flight)
    -> InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)
        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, offlineMessage)   (FR-010)
        CreateEntryUseCase(text, manual)
            Right(entry)  -> entry appended to EntriesRepository.cachedEntries -> modal closes (FR-011)
            Left(failure) -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, failure.message)                              (FR-009)

[Áudio tab — opens idle; recording starts only once the user taps the start control, FR-004]
  TabSelected(audio) -> InsertionModalAudioIdle()                                                # round start control, "Toque para gravar", no permission check yet
  AudioStartRequested (from InsertionModalAudioIdle)
    -> AudioCaptureRepository.hasPermission() == false -> InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied
    -> else: AudioCaptureRepository.start() -> InsertionModalAudioRecording(elapsed: 0:00)      # waveform widget subscribes directly to the amplitude stream (research.md R6/contracts)
  (timer ticks update `elapsed` only — no network, no recognition yet)
  AudioStopRequested
    -> path = AudioCaptureRepository.stop(); _pendingAudioPath = path
    -> InsertionModalAudioSaving()                                                               # plain generic loading indicator (FR-007)
        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(offlineMessage)   (FR-010 — checked before transcribing at all, research.md R5)
        AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(path, lang: 'pt')
            Left(EmptyRecognitionResult()) -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(noSpeechMessage)   (Edge Cases: silence — the repository itself guarantees this, never Right(''))
            Left(TranscriptionError())     -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(genericMessage)     (FR-009)
            Right(text) -> CreateEntryUseCase(text, audio)
                Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingAudioPath cleared; modal closes
                Left(failure) -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(failure.message)     # audio file still held — RetryRequested re-enters AudioStopRequested's saving branch without a fresh recording
  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalAudioFailure, _pendingAudioPath != null)
    -> re-run the InsertionModalAudioSaving branch above against the same _pendingAudioPath
  TabSelected(<anything else>) while InsertionModalAudioRecording
    -> AudioCaptureRepository.discard(); _pendingAudioPath = null; emit the target tab's idle state   (Edge Cases)

[Foto tab]
  TabSelected(photo) -> InsertionModalFotoCaptura()                                               # two buttons, no image yet (FR-005)
  PhotoSourceSelected(camera | gallery)
    -> PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)
        null (user cancelled the OS picker) -> stays InsertionModalFotoCaptura()                   (Edge Cases/User Story 4)
        path -> _pendingImagePath = path; InsertionModalFotoSaving()                                # plain generic loading indicator (FR-007)
            ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(offlineMessage)   (FR-010)
            PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize(path)
                Left(OcrNoTextFailure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(noTextMessage)   (Edge Cases: illegible/blank image — the repository normalizes a blank-text 200 response to this same failure, never Right(''))
                Left(otherFailure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(failure.message)
                Right(text) [confidence ignored — Clarification 3] -> CreateEntryUseCase(text, photo)
                    Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingImagePath cleared; modal closes
                    Left(failure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(failure.message)   # image still held — RetryRequested re-enters this branch
  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalFotoFailure, _pendingImagePath != null)
    -> re-run the recognize+create branch above against the same _pendingImagePath

[Any tab, any sub-state] ModalClosed (close button, scrim tap, system back)
  -> AudioCaptureRepository.discard() if a recording is in progress; bloc disposed; nothing persisted  (FR-008, User Story 4)
```

## Backend `Failure` (reused, not redefined) vs. the new local `RecognitionFailure`

| Repository | Return type | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `EntriesRepository.create()` | `Either<Failure, Entry>` | Real network call; reuses F000's closed 13-code hierarchy unchanged. |
| `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` | `Either<Failure, OcrResult>` | Real network call to `media-ocr`; `OcrNoTextFailure`/`OCR_NO_TEXT` already exists in `failure.dart` from F000 and covers the illegible/blank-image Edge Case directly. |
| `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` | `Either<RecognitionFailure, String>` | On-device only, no network call — `RecognitionFailure` (`emptyResult`\|`transcriptionError`) is a new, small sealed type local to `capture/domain/`, not added to `core/network/failure.dart` (research.md R7). |

Three write-endpoint failure scenarios this unit's own `mocktail` tests cover, toward RNF09's
running 15-scenario total (`entries-create` and `media-ocr` are two of the spec's five write
endpoints):

| Endpoint | Scenario | Expected `Failure` |
|---|---|---|
| `entries-create` | Timeout / No connection / Malformed response | `NetworkTimeoutFailure` / `NetworkOfflineFailure` / `ValidationFailure` |
| `media-ocr` | Timeout / No connection / Malformed response | `NetworkTimeoutFailure` / `NetworkOfflineFailure` / `ValidationFailure` |

## Design Tokens (`lib/core/design_tokens.dart`)

No additions — see research.md R10. Every value the three tabs need (primary/outline/text
buttons, text field states, `colorError`, `sizeLoadingIndicator`/`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator`,
spacing, radii, type scale) already exists from F000/RF03.

1	# Contract: `InsertionModalBloc` (`lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/`)
2	
3	One screen-scoped bloc for the whole modal (same "one bloc per screen, flat sealed sub-states"
4	shape as `VaultBloc` — RF03 research.md R4), created fresh by `BlocProvider` every time
5	`showModalBottomSheet` opens the modal and disposed when it closes — which is what makes FR-002's
6	"reset every tab... each time the modal is freshly opened" true without an explicit reset event.
7	
8	```dart
9	sealed class InsertionModalState extends Equatable {}
10	
11	class InsertionModalTexto extends InsertionModalState { final String text; }
12	class InsertionModalTextoSaving extends InsertionModalState { final String text; }
13	class InsertionModalTextoFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String text; final String message; }
14	
15	class InsertionModalAudioIdle extends InsertionModalState {}
16	class InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied extends InsertionModalState {}
17	class InsertionModalAudioRecording extends InsertionModalState { final Duration elapsed; }
18	class InsertionModalAudioSaving extends InsertionModalState {}
19	class InsertionModalAudioFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String message; }
20	
21	class InsertionModalFotoCaptura extends InsertionModalState {}
22	class InsertionModalFotoPermissionDenied extends InsertionModalState {}
23	class InsertionModalFotoSaving extends InsertionModalState {}
24	class InsertionModalFotoFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String message; }
25	
26	sealed class InsertionModalEvent {}
27	class TabSelected extends InsertionModalEvent { final CaptureTab tab; }
28	class TextDraftChanged extends InsertionModalEvent { final String text; }
29	class SaveTextSubmitted extends InsertionModalEvent {}
30	class AudioStartRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
31	class AudioTimerTicked extends InsertionModalEvent {}          // internal, drives `elapsed` only
32	class AudioStopRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
33	class PhotoSourceSelected extends InsertionModalEvent { final PhotoSource source; }
34	class RetryRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
35	class ModalClosed extends InsertionModalEvent {}
36	
37	enum CaptureTab { texto, audio, foto }
38	```
39	
40	- **Initial state**: `const InsertionModalTexto(text: '')` — no `ModalOpened`/async-resolution
41	  event is needed (unlike `VaultBloc`'s `VaultOpened`, which has to await
42	  `DetermineVaultEntryUseCase` first); the Texto tab's default state is static and synchronous
43	  (FR-002).
44	- **`TabSelected(audio)`**: -> `InsertionModalAudioIdle()` unconditionally — a round start control
45	  with the "Toque para gravar" caption; no permission check and no recording yet (FR-004).
46	- **`AudioStartRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioIdle`): calls
47	  `AudioCaptureRepository.hasPermission()`; `false` -> `InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied` (Edge
48	  Cases: explanatory message, no controls); `true` -> `AudioCaptureRepository.start()` ->
49	  `InsertionModalAudioRecording(elapsed: Duration.zero)`, and starts a local 1-second ticker that
50	  dispatches `AudioTimerTicked` to advance `elapsed` (the waveform's own visual animation reads
51	  `AudioCaptureRepository.amplitudeStream` directly, not through this bloc —
52	  contracts/audio-capture-repository.md).
53	- **`TabSelected(foto)`**: -> `InsertionModalFotoCaptura()` unconditionally (camera/gallery
54	  permission is requested per-button-tap by `image_picker` itself, not up front — Edge Cases'
55	  permission-denied message is shown by catching that attempt's resulting `null`/exception in
56	  `PhotoSourceSelected`'s handler, not by a pre-check here).
57	- **`TabSelected(texto)`**: -> `InsertionModalTexto(text: _textDraft)`, restoring whatever was
58	  typed before switching away (an ordinary tab-switch convenience, not itself FR-required, but
59	  consistent with FR-002 only mandating a reset on a *fresh modal open*, not on every tab
60	  revisit).
61	- **`TabSelected(<anything>)` while `InsertionModalAudioRecording`**: calls
62	  `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` before transitioning to the target tab's state (Edge Cases:
63	  switching tabs mid-recording discards it).
64	- **`SaveTextSubmitted`** (ignored if `state is InsertionModalTextoSaving` — double-tap guard,
65	  Assumptions): `-> InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)` then awaits `SaveTextEntryUseCase(text)`;
66	  `Right(entry)` closes the modal (the page listens for this via `BlocListener`, pops the sheet);
67	  `Left(failure)` -> `InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, failure.message)`.
68	- **`AudioStopRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioRecording`): stops the
69	  ticker, calls `AudioCaptureRepository.stop()` to get the file path (stored in the bloc-private
70	  `_pendingAudioPath`), emits `InsertionModalAudioSaving()`, then awaits
71	  `SaveAudioEntryUseCase(path)` and maps its three-way failure (data-model.md's transition table)
72	  to `InsertionModalAudioFailure` with the matching message, or closes the modal on success.
73	- **`PhotoSourceSelected(source)`** (ignored if `state is InsertionModalFotoSaving`): calls
74	  `PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)`; `null` -> stays `InsertionModalFotoCaptura()`
75	  (cancelled); a path -> stores it in `_pendingImagePath`, emits `InsertionModalFotoSaving()`, then
76	  awaits `SavePhotoEntryUseCase(path)`, same failure-mapping shape as audio.
77	- **`RetryRequested`**: re-dispatches the same saving branch against whichever of
78	  `_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath` is non-null for the tab the failure state belongs to — no
79	  re-recording, no re-picking (FR-009).
80	- **`ModalClosed`**: calls `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` if a recording is in flight; the

# Contract: `InsertionModalBloc` (`lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/`)

One screen-scoped bloc for the whole modal (same "one bloc per screen, flat sealed sub-states"
shape as `VaultBloc` — RF03 research.md R4), created fresh by `BlocProvider` every time
`showModalBottomSheet` opens the modal and disposed when it closes — which is what makes FR-002's
"reset every tab... each time the modal is freshly opened" true without an explicit reset event.

```dart
sealed class InsertionModalState extends Equatable {}

class InsertionModalTexto extends InsertionModalState { final String text; }
class InsertionModalTextoSaving extends InsertionModalState { final String text; }
class InsertionModalTextoFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String text; final String message; }

class InsertionModalAudioIdle extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalAudioRecording extends InsertionModalState { final Duration elapsed; }
class InsertionModalAudioSaving extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalAudioFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String message; }

class InsertionModalFotoCaptura extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalFotoPermissionDenied extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalFotoSaving extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalFotoFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String message; }

sealed class InsertionModalEvent {}
class TabSelected extends InsertionModalEvent { final CaptureTab tab; }
class TextDraftChanged extends InsertionModalEvent { final String text; }
class SaveTextSubmitted extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class AudioStartRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class AudioTimerTicked extends InsertionModalEvent {}          // internal, drives `elapsed` only
class AudioStopRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class PhotoSourceSelected extends InsertionModalEvent { final PhotoSource source; }
class RetryRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class ModalClosed extends InsertionModalEvent {}

enum CaptureTab { texto, audio, foto }
```

- **Initial state**: `const InsertionModalTexto(text: '')` — no `ModalOpened`/async-resolution
  event is needed (unlike `VaultBloc`'s `VaultOpened`, which has to await
  `DetermineVaultEntryUseCase` first); the Texto tab's default state is static and synchronous
  (FR-002).
- **`TabSelected(audio)`**: -> `InsertionModalAudioIdle()` unconditionally — a round start control
  with the "Toque para gravar" caption; no permission check and no recording yet (FR-004).
- **`AudioStartRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioIdle`): calls
  `AudioCaptureRepository.hasPermission()`; `false` -> `InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied` (Edge
  Cases: explanatory message, no controls); `true` -> `AudioCaptureRepository.start()` ->
  `InsertionModalAudioRecording(elapsed: Duration.zero)`, and starts a local 1-second ticker that
  dispatches `AudioTimerTicked` to advance `elapsed` (the waveform's own visual animation reads
  `AudioCaptureRepository.amplitudeStream` directly, not through this bloc —
  contracts/audio-capture-repository.md).
- **`TabSelected(foto)`**: -> `InsertionModalFotoCaptura()` unconditionally (camera/gallery
  permission is requested per-button-tap by `image_picker` itself, not up front — Edge Cases'
  permission-denied message is shown by catching that attempt's resulting `null`/exception in
  `PhotoSourceSelected`'s handler, not by a pre-check here).
- **`TabSelected(texto)`**: -> `InsertionModalTexto(text: _textDraft)`, restoring whatever was
  typed before switching away (an ordinary tab-switch convenience, not itself FR-required, but
  consistent with FR-002 only mandating a reset on a *fresh modal open*, not on every tab
  revisit).
- **`TabSelected(<anything>)` while `InsertionModalAudioRecording`**: calls
  `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` before transitioning to the target tab's state (Edge Cases:
  switching tabs mid-recording discards it).
- **`SaveTextSubmitted`** (ignored if `state is InsertionModalTextoSaving` — double-tap guard,
  Assumptions): `-> InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)` then awaits `SaveTextEntryUseCase(text)`;
  `Right(entry)` closes the modal (the page listens for this via `BlocListener`, pops the sheet);
  `Left(failure)` -> `InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, failure.message)`.
- **`AudioStopRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioRecording`): stops the
  ticker, calls `AudioCaptureRepository.stop()` to get the file path (stored in the bloc-private
  `_pendingAudioPath`), emits `InsertionModalAudioSaving()`, then awaits
  `SaveAudioEntryUseCase(path)` and maps its three-way failure (data-model.md's transition table)
  to `InsertionModalAudioFailure` with the matching message, or closes the modal on success.
- **`PhotoSourceSelected(source)`** (ignored if `state is InsertionModalFotoSaving`): calls
  `PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)`; `null` -> stays `InsertionModalFotoCaptura()`
  (cancelled); a path -> stores it in `_pendingImagePath`, emits `InsertionModalFotoSaving()`, then
  awaits `SavePhotoEntryUseCase(path)`, same failure-mapping shape as audio.
- **`RetryRequested`**: re-dispatches the same saving branch against whichever of
  `_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath` is non-null for the tab the failure state belongs to — no
  re-recording, no re-picking (FR-009).
- **`ModalClosed`**: calls `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` if a recording is in flight; the
  bloc is then disposed by `BlocProvider` as the sheet closes — nothing further to do (FR-008).
- **What the page does, not the bloc**: on any transition into a "success" condition (handled as a
  one-shot side effect, not a state — see `save-usecases.md`), `InsertionModalPage` is the one that
  calls `Navigator.pop` to close the sheet (FR-011: "the modal closes and return[s] the user to
  Home/Chat with no other visible change"). The bloc's own state never needs a dedicated
  `InsertionModalSuccess` case precisely because there is nothing to render for it — the sheet is
  simply gone.

## Who depends on this

`InsertionModalPage` and its three tab widgets (`TextoTabView`, `AudioTabView`, `FotoTabView`) —
each renders only the sub-states relevant to its own tab via `state is InsertionModal<Tab>*`
pattern matching, the same exhaustive-`switch` convention `VaultBloc`/`VaultPage` already use. The
waveform widget additionally reads `AudioCaptureRepository.amplitudeStream` via `get_it` directly
(the one sanctioned bypass of "always through the bloc," justified in
contracts/audio-capture-repository.md).
